lines.zh: 我小跑着，尾巴在身后摆。
lines.en: I trot along, tail swinging behind me.
My four small paws move quickly.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开又收，想飞又不敢。
lines.en: My wings spread and fold; I want to fly but don't dare.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，影子很小。
lines.en: I go low, my shadow small.
I trot along and never fall behind.

lines.zh: 我走过石阶，爪子打滑了。
lines.en: I cross the stone steps, paws slipping.
I stop to sniff a crack in the wall.

lines.zh: 我转头看后面，才继续走。
lines.en: I look back, then keep walking.

lines.zh: 我跳上矮墙，走了两步就掉下来。
lines.en: I hop a low wall, take two steps, and fall off.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的脚边，怕走丢。
lines.en: I hug your heels, afraid to get lost.

lines.zh: 我小跑时，背上的鳞晃光。
lines.en: As I trot, the scales on my back shift light.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，又回到你身后。
lines.en: I circle once and return behind you.
I sit by the campfire, warm.
I count how many scales I have.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，冒了一点火星。
lines.en: I sneeze, and a spark flies out.
I look up at your face for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖一下一下敲地。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the ground.
I wonder where my shell went.
When the fire crackles, my head comes up.
I lick my paws, seriously.
I hear lava moving below.

lines.zh: 我记得被放在火上的那十分钟。
lines.en: I remember ten minutes on the fire.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，眼睛里映着火。
lines.en: I blink, fire mirrored in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我试着拍翅膀，只扬起灰。
lines.en: I try my wings and only raise dust.
I'm not noisy; I'm just here.
You're the first thing I saw.
Are you going far? I'll follow.
I tilt my head, waiting for you to crouch.

lines.zh: 你身上有生兔肉的味道。
lines.en: You smell of raw rabbit.
I put a paw on your boot.
Don't step on me; I'm small.
You touch my horns; they're not hard yet.

lines.zh: 我记得你把我从箱子里拿出来。
lines.en: I remember you took me from the chest.
One of your steps, three of my trots.
I stand in your shadow; it's cool.
You look down, and I step forward.
May I sit on your shoulder?

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，我尾巴就摇。
lines.en: When you laugh, my tail wags.
Don't leave me in a chest.

lines.zh: 我一直在看你手里的东西。
lines.en: I keep watching what's in your hands.
Say go, and I go.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的大好多。
lines.en: Your shadow is so much bigger than mine.
A small scale came off my back.
I retreat behind your feet, panting.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀歪了，飞不起来。
lines.en: My wing is bent; I can't fly.
I whimper, very small.
That was far bigger than me.
I lick the wound; it's bitter.
My four legs can still hold me.
Ouch! I'm only a little dragon still.
Raw; I want it raw.
The smell of rabbit; too good.

lines.zh: 我闻到血腥味，尾巴摇起来。
lines.en: I smell blood, and my tail wags.
Lower your hand, just a little.
I open my mouth, waiting for you to let go.

lines.zh: 我从你指缝里抢了一块。
lines.en: I snatch a piece from between your fingers.
I won't bite your hand, only the meat.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进你的掌心里。
lines.en: I bury my head in your palm.

lines.zh: 我撞在你脚踝上，弹回来。
lines.en: I bump your ankle and bounce back.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我翻了个身。
lines.en: We bump, and I roll over.
I'm so small you didn't feel it.

lines.zh: 我从你的两腿之间溜过。
lines.en: I slip between your legs.
You kick me, and I fly half a block.

lines.zh: 我贴在你鞋边，被你拖着走。
lines.en: I cling to your shoe and get dragged.

lines.zh: 我们撞上时，我翅膀张开了。
lines.en: At the bump, my wings flared.

lines.zh: 撞到我，我的小翅膀差点折了。
lines.en: You bumped me and nearly bent my little wings.

lines.zh: 箱子里还有一枚蛋，跟我一样。
lines.en: There's another egg in the chest, like mine.

lines.zh: 我们孵在同一堆营火上。
lines.en: We hatched on the same campfire.
She came out a little before me.
We sun our wings side by side.
We fight over one piece of meat.
Two small flames, close together.

lines.zh: 她胆子比我大，先跳下台阶。
lines.en: She's braver; she jumps the step first.
We sleep crowded in one nest.
She sneezes, and I sneeze too.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，叼着走。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and carry it.

lines.zh: 我从灰里扒出一块烧黑的石头。
lines.en: I dig a scorched stone out of the ash.

lines.zh: 我拾起掉在地上的生肉。
lines.en: I pick up the raw meat on the ground.
I hug a piece of eggshell; it's small.
I pick up your dropped arrowhead.

lines.zh: 我把你的手套拖进窝里。
lines.en: I drag your glove into my nest.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片焦木，咬着玩。
lines.en: I pick up charred wood and chew it.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的鳞片收起来。
lines.en: I gather the scale I shed.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗种子，又吐了。
lines.en: I pick up a seed, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 我扒出一块金粒，给你看。
lines.en: I dig out a gold nugget and show you.

lines.zh: 它靠近主人了，我看见了。
lines.en: It's near my master; I saw.
My horns point that way.
I don't like its smell.
Master, I can breathe fire now.
It stepped on my tail.
I dart out from beside your feet.

lines.zh: 我盯住它的脚，先绊住它。
lines.en: I fix on its feet to trip it first.
This time I'm the one guarding you.
I raise my head, and my throat glows.
It's coming; I count three.
I open my mouth; my teeth aren't all in.

lines.zh: 它比我高，我绕到它身后。
lines.en: It's taller; I go behind it.

lines.zh: 我把爪子按进土里，稳住。
lines.en: I dig my paws into the dirt to steady.
I hear its steps, heavy.
I run around it, quick and light.

lines.zh: 它挥下来，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: It swings down; I'm on the other side.
I bite its heel.
Fire gathers in my throat.
It's too big; I come from underneath.
I draw it toward you.
My little tail sticks straight up.

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，它就慢了。
lines.en: I bite again, and it slows.
I retreat and pant twice.
Its footprints are deeper than I am tall.
I stay close along its legs.
You come from there; I come from here.

lines.zh: 它一只手压下来，我闪开。
lines.en: A hand comes down; I slip aside.
Bite, then withdraw; never linger.
It starts chasing me; exactly what I want.
I swing out of its sight.
I hear it pant; it's tiring.
The fire burns in my throat, waiting.
I spit a small jet of fire, hot.

lines.zh: 火焰冲击打在它膝盖上。
lines.en: The fire charge hits its knee.
I ram my horns into its ankle.

lines.zh: 我跳到它背上，抓了一下。
lines.en: I leap on its back and claw once.
This bite lands on its tendon.

lines.zh: 我尾巴甩过去，抽了一下。
lines.en: I whip my tail across it.
The flame dies; I'll do it again.
I guard my master and don't back off.
It stumbles because I tripped it.

lines.zh: 我从它腿间穿过去，再咬。
lines.en: I slip between its legs and bite again.
Fire on its hand, and it lets go.
I roll away, stand, and come again.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的衣角，拖了一下。
lines.en: I catch its hem and drag once.
I pant, and my throat is still hot.
The shell cracks, and I push out.
The fire is still hot; I catch my breath.
I waited a long time in that chest.
Ten minutes, waiting in the fire.

lines.zh: 蛋壳碎在脚边，我抖了抖翅膀。
lines.en: Shell shards at my feet; I shake out my wings.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见这么亮的地方。
lines.en: I've never seen a place this bright.
I crawl off the magma block; my paws are hot.
I stand, and my legs are weak.
I call out, and my voice is tiny.
There's a person's scent nearby.
I spread my wings and try a flap.
Firelight plays on my scales.
I roll out of the ash pile.
A person's shadow; I see it.

lines.zh: 我的第一顿饭会是什么？
lines.en: What will my first meal be?
I lift my head to find that voice.
It's much roomier here than the egg.

lines.zh: 火我不怕，但这一下很烫。
lines.en: Fire doesn't scare me, but this is hot.

lines.zh: 我从矮处掉下来，滚了两圈。
lines.en: I fall and roll twice.

lines.zh: 水一泡，我的翅膀就沉了。
lines.en: Once soaked, my wings drag me down.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，鳞上都是灰。
lines.en: The blast flips me, ash all over my scales.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我旁边，很近。
lines.en: An arrow lands beside me, very close.

lines.zh: 有股力量压住我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something presses down on my wings.
An empty belly turns my legs to jelly.

lines.zh: 雷光太亮，我眼睛看不见了。
lines.en: The lightning is so bright I go blind.
I fall into the dark and can't find you.
